title: Blendity test checklist
about: Every feature, as an artist reaches it. Time each task from your first move to the result; a task over 1.5x its target is marked slow. Targets are an expert's times from the keystroke-level model (docs/hci/klm.md) or estimates on the same rules; the first time through, expect to be slower.

items.task: Switch to the Animation layout and back to Default
items.steps: Layout dropdown (top right) > Animation; then > Default
items.expect: Windows rearrange; the guide strip says the layout's purpose

items.task: Open a window that isn't shown
items.steps: Window > Live Link
items.expect: Live Link opens as a tab beside the Hierarchy

items.task: Change the editor feel to Blender and back
items.steps: Edit > Editor Feel > Blender; then > Unity
items.expect: MMB orbits in Blender's feel; RMB + WASD flies in Unity's

items.task: Set the theme to Light, then High Contrast, then Dark
items.steps: Edit > Preferences > Theme
items.expect: All text readable in each; dim text still legible

items.steps: Edit > Preferences > UI Scale 1.5
items.expect: Everything larger; long Preferences scroll; labels end in ... with tooltips where cut

items.task: Turn layout guides off and on
items.steps: Edit > Preferences > Layout guides
items.expect: The guide strip under the tabs hides and shows

items.steps: Ctrl+K, type unwrap, Enter
items.expect: The selected mesh is unwrapped

items.task: Pin a command to Quick Favorites
items.steps: Ctrl+K, right-click a row > Add to Quick Favorites; Shift+Q
items.expect: The command shows in Quick Favorites

items.steps: Move a cube three times; Ctrl+Z x3; Ctrl+Y x3
items.expect: Each step back and forward; Edit > History lists them

items.steps: Select Cube, F
items.expect: The Scene view centres and fits the cube

items.task: Orbit, pan and zoom with the mouse (Unity feel)
items.steps: Alt+LMB orbit, MMB pan, wheel zoom
items.expect: Smooth, no jumps

items.steps: Drag the Scene Gizmo; drag the hand below it to pan
items.expect: The view follows the pen

items.steps: Drag a rectangle over Cube, Sphere and Cylinder
items.expect: Three selected; the Inspector shows multi-edit

items.task: Snap a move to the grid
items.steps: Hold Ctrl while moving the cube
items.expect: Steps of the Move snap (0.25 m)

items.task: Look through the top view and back
items.steps: Click the gizmo's Y; then Persp
items.expect: An orthographic top view; perspective again

items.task: Parent the Sphere under the Cube
items.steps: Drag Sphere onto Cube in the Hierarchy
items.expect: Sphere indents under Cube; moving Cube moves it

items.steps: Double-click it in the Hierarchy, type, Enter
items.expect: The new name everywhere

items.steps: Inspector > Add Component, type light, Enter
items.expect: A Light component on the object

items.task: Edit a field on three objects at once
items.steps: Select three, change Position Y
items.expect: All three move; a differing field shows a dash

items.task: Pin the Inspector and select something else
items.steps: Inspector > Pin; click another object
items.expect: The Inspector keeps the pinned object

items.task: Pick a modifier's vertex group from the list
items.steps: Add a Smooth modifier on a mesh with groups; Vertex Group dropdown
items.expect: The mesh's groups listed; picking one limits the smoothing

items.task: Add and remove a shape key
items.steps: Inspector > MeshRenderer > Add Shape Key; Remove... > Key 1
items.expect: BlendShape/Key 1 appears, then goes

items.task: Add a cube and bevel its edges
items.steps: GameObject > 3D Object > Cube; Tab; 2 (edges); select all; Bevel
items.expect: Rounded edges; F9 adjusts the last operation

items.steps: Edit Mode, 3 (faces), click a face, E, drag
items.expect: A new face pulled out

items.steps: Edit Mode, Ctrl+R over an edge ring, click
items.expect: A loop across the ring

items.task: Mirror a half model along Y
items.steps: Modeling Tools > Mirror Y
items.expect: The mirrored half added, faces doubled

items.steps: Add Component > Subdivision Surface, Levels 2
items.expect: Smooth surface, cage kept

items.steps: Select cutter then target; Modeling Tools > Difference
items.expect: The cutter's shape removed

items.steps: Modeling Tools > Clear Custom Normals
items.expect: Shading follows the faces and smooth angle

items.task: Undo a bevel's segments in F9
items.steps: After a bevel, F9; change Segments to 4
items.expect: The bevel redone with 4 segments

items.task: Add a guide line by numbers
items.steps: Edit Mode tools > Guide Through X/Y/Z, Guide Direction > Add Guide Line
items.expect: A construction line appears

items.task: Draw a rectangle on the ground and push-pull it
items.steps: Mesh > Draw > Rectangle; click twice; P, drag
items.expect: A box from the rectangle

items.task: Sketch with the pen in red
items.steps: Mesh > Draw > Pen Color > Red; draw a stroke
items.expect: A red stroke, corrected to a line or curve

items.steps: Mesh > Draw > Steadiness > Strong; draw
items.expect: The line trails the pen and comes out smooth

items.steps: Mesh > Draw > Canvas > The Ground; draw
items.expect: The stroke lies on the ground in 3D

items.steps: Mesh > Draw > Guides > 3-Point Perspective; draw lines
items.expect: Lines snap to the vanishing points

items.task: Lift a corner's three lines to 3D
items.steps: Draw three lines toward the axes; Mesh > Draw > Lift the Sketch to 3D
items.expect: A Scaffold wire object

items.steps: Mesh > Draw > Clear the Sketch; Ctrl+Z
items.expect: Strokes gone, then back

items.task: Build a box from three lines
items.steps: Mesh > Draw > Build from Sketch > Box
items.expect: A box mesh from the sketched corner

items.steps: UV Unwrapping layout > Smart UV
items.expect: Islands packed in 0-1, no overlaps

items.task: Mark seams from sharp edges and unwrap
items.steps: UV editor > Seams from Sharp
items.expect: Seams on sharp edges, unwrapped

items.task: Part Unwrap at a looser bound
items.steps: UV editor > Parts > 1.5; then Part Unwrap
items.expect: Fewer charts; the options alone don't unwrap

items.task: Edit only two materials' UVs, the others hidden
items.steps: UV editor > material list > tick two; Others Hidden
items.expect: Only their faces shown and editable

items.steps: Select an island; type 90 in the field; Rotate
items.expect: The island turns 90 degrees

items.steps: UV editor > Stretch
items.expect: Faces coloured blue / green / red by distortion

items.task: UV editor in a narrow window
items.steps: Shrink the UV editor below about 700 px
items.expect: Its right-hand controls move to their own row; nothing overlaps

items.task: Give an object a new material and change its color
items.steps: Inspector > Material > New; Base Color
items.expect: The object recolours

items.steps: GameObject > New Surface
items.expect: A texture stack on the object

items.steps: GameObject > Bake Mesh Maps...; size 1024; Bake
items.expect: AO, curvature and thickness baked

items.steps: Textures > a layer's menu > Mask Preset > edgewear
items.expect: Wear on the edges

items.task: Read one layer's mask from another (Anchor)
items.steps: Name a layer; add an Anchor to another's mask; pick the name from Layer
items.expect: The anchored mask reused

items.task: Save a layer group as a smart material
items.steps: Layer menu > Save as Smart Material...
items.expect: A free name offered; it appears in the shelf

items.task: Paint a stroke on the model
items.steps: Paint section > Paint; drag over the model
items.expect: Paint follows the surface

items.steps: Paint > Bucket Fill (Island); click the model
items.expect: That island filled; a miss fills nothing

items.steps: Sculpt > Clay; drag; Shift-drag
items.expect: Clay builds; Shift smooths

items.task: Make the sculpt brush bigger by one step
items.expect: Radius up a quarter

items.task: Export the textures to a folder
items.steps: Textures > Export Textures...; type or pick a folder
items.expect: PNG maps written

items.task: Give an object the anime rock look
items.steps: GameObject > Anime Look > Rock
items.expect: Flat-toned toon rock

items.steps: Strokes > Grass Density / Height / Radius; Grass under the View's Middle
items.expect: Upright blades on the surface

items.steps: Strokes > New Stroke Object; paint
items.expect: A new Stroke object holds the new cards

items.steps: Strokes > Canopy Centre from Strokes; Fill Canopy
items.expect: A round shell of cards

items.steps: Scatter > Source; Seed 7; dab
items.expect: A different arrangement for the same dab

items.steps: Lighting > Sky: sun disc; fog on
items.expect: A sun in the sky; distance fog

items.task: Aim a light at a point by numbers
items.steps: Select the light; Inspector > Aim X/Y/Z; Aim at These Numbers
items.expect: The light turns toward the point

items.steps: Lighting > Generate Lighting
items.expect: Lightmaps baked in the background; the view stays responsive
The Render window shows the frame

items.steps: Render window > First 30, Last 40, Frame Rate 12; Render Animation
items.expect: 11 PNGs and an MP4

items.task: Render a camera sequence to a folder
items.steps: Render window > Sequence Folder; Render Camera Sequence
items.expect: One image per camera in that folder

items.steps: Render window > Preview with the path tracer
items.expect: Noise clears progressively

items.steps: Editing window > Render; adjust Exposure
items.expect: The picture brightens; Save keeps an .edit

items.task: Point Blendity at your own ffmpeg
items.steps: Preferences > FFmpeg; type the path, Enter
items.expect: Render Animation uses it

items.steps: Preferences > Renderers > Check
items.expect: A test render's result and time

items.steps: Rigging > Humanoid Rig
items.expect: A skeleton with IK on hands and feet

items.steps: Rigging > Auto-Rig; place the markers; Build
items.expect: A fitted skeleton

items.task: Skin a mesh with automatic weights
items.steps: Select the mesh and the armature; Bind
items.expect: The mesh follows the bones

items.steps: Rigging > Weight Paint; Clean Below 0.05; Clean
items.expect: Weights under 0.05 become 0

items.task: Rig hair from a mesh with 4 locks of 2 bones
items.steps: Rigging > Rig Hair from Mesh...; Locks 4, Bones a Lock 2; Rig
items.expect: Spring-bone chains, the mesh skinned

items.steps: Select bones; Add Component > Spring Bones
items.expect: Bones sway in Play

areas.name: Animation, Puppet Posing, physics and AI

items.task: Key a position at frame 0 and 30
items.steps: Animation window > New clip; move; Shift+K at 0 and 30
items.expect: Two keys; the object moves between them

items.task: Pose a reach by the hand (Puppet Posing)
items.steps: AutoPosing on; drag the hand's dot
items.expect: The body follows, feet planted

items.task: Pose with the learned prior (local AI install)
items.steps: Puppet > Use the Pose Prior; drag the hand toward the knee
items.expect: The spine bends naturally; the hand reaches exactly

items.steps: Select the foot bone; Puppet > Lock the Selected Bone
items.expect: It stays put while the body moves

items.task: Mark a contact on the foot at the playhead
items.steps: Puppet > Contacts > Add One Here
items.expect: A bar under the ruler, 10 frames

items.task: Find and fix a foot slide
items.steps: Puppet > Motion Check; a row's Fix
items.expect: The slide gone; the report one row shorter

items.steps: Puppet > Motion Trails; Onion Skin
items.expect: A hand's path with key dots; ghosts before and after

items.task: Pose a neighbouring frame in the Zoetrope
items.steps: Puppet > Zoetrope; drag a hand in the +2 cell
items.expect: That frame keyed, the playhead unmoved

items.steps: Curves view; right-click a key; In 0.5
items.expect: The key goes Broken with that slope

items.task: AI Inbetween a span (local AI install)
items.steps: AI Inbetween; Apply
items.expect: A ghost between the keys, then keys

items.task: AI: a span by frame numbers
items.steps: AI ... options > From / To > Make This Span
items.expect: Only that span made

items.steps: Puppet > Ragdoll Events > Go Limp Here; Ragdoll
items.expect: The body falls and settles

items.task: Generate a walk cycle and keep the style
items.steps: Rigging > Walk Cycle > Generate into the Clip; Save Style
items.expect: A walking clip; Assets/Gaits/<name>.gait

items.task: Make a sequence of two clips
items.steps: Sequencer > Create; drop two clips on a track
items.expect: Bars on the timeline; preview plays them

items.steps: Sequencer > Add Trigger; click its key; press J
items.expect: J jumps to its clip in Play

items.steps: Ctrl+P (or the Play button) twice
items.expect: The scene runs; edits made in Play are put back

items.steps: File > Import... (or drop it on the Scene view)
items.expect: A preview, then the character with its textures

items.steps: File > Export...; glTF; Selection only
items.expect: A .glb that opens in Blender

items.task: Add a reference image from the side
items.steps: Reference & Planning; GameObject > Reference Image > Side > an image
items.expect: A plane facing the side view

items.task: Save the scene and open a new one
items.steps: Ctrl+S; Ctrl+N
items.expect: Saved; a new scene; unsaved changes prompt if any

items.task: Find an asset in the Project window
items.steps: Project > Search: brick
items.expect: Matching assets listed

items.steps: Window > Live Link > Start
items.expect: Listening on 40100 (or the next free port)

items.steps: Live Link > Install a Bridge > Blender
items.expect: The add-on installed and enabled

items.steps: Open Blender with Blendity running
items.expect: Blender's panel: Connected to Blendity; edits stream

items.task: Install the Unity bridge into a project
items.steps: Live Link > Install a Bridge > Unity Project...; pick the folder
items.expect: The package in Packages; Unity connects

items.steps: Install a Bridge > Godot Project...
items.expect: addons/blendity_livelink, enabled in project.godot

items.steps: Install a Bridge > Unreal Project...
items.expect: Plugins/BlendityLiveLink, listed in the .uproject

areas.name: Palette, Wheel, My Tools and UI files

items.task: Open the Wheel and pick a slice
items.steps: Space over the Scene view; click a slice
items.expect: The command runs

items.task: Add a command to a Wheel ring
items.steps: Preferences > Wheel > Into Ring; Pick a Command...; type, click
items.expect: The command in that ring; Preferences stays open

items.steps: My Tools > +; name it; right-click a menu row > Add to My Tools
items.expect: A panel with that button

items.steps: Ctrl+K, right-click a row > Assign Shortcut...; press keys
items.expect: The shortcut runs it

items.task: Save your UI to a file and load it
items.steps: Preferences > UI file > Save...; Load
items.expect: Layout, keys and panels restored

items.task: Open a lesson and use its Try It
items.steps: Learn > a lesson > Try it
items.expect: The scene set up as the lesson says

items.steps: Learn > a question > reveal
items.expect: The answer and the feature named

items.task: Read a tooltip on a cut-off button
items.steps: Hover a button whose label ends in ...
items.expect: The whole label first, then its help

items.steps: In Play, try Set Key; click the toast's Fix
items.expect: Play stops; the key can be set

items.steps: Benchmark scene million; orbit
items.expect: Smooth (the status bar's fps at 30 or more on the GPU)

items.steps: Tab on a big mesh; select and move a face
items.expect: No pause over a fraction of a second

items.steps: Start Blendity; F12
items.expect: The first render as fast as the second (no long cold start)

items.steps: Shrink the window
items.expect: Nothing overlaps; long labels end in ...
